source.name: Authored: encoding damage and machine-shaped values
source.notes: Strings whose date is sound but whose text was damaged on the way: mojibake apostrophes and dashes (a UTF-8 character read in another encoding, as in yearrange's '1750âs'), and date-column values written as eight digits with zeros for an unknown month or day ('18690000'). The normaliser repairs these before the grammar runs and says so in a note. Written 2026-10-17 after the first Claude interpreter run over the disputed yearrange entries read them the way a cataloguer would; expectations checked by hand under the default profile.

entries.notes: Both apostrophes repaired; the default decade bands give late = 7-9 and early = 0-3.
A trailing band word qualifies the decade before it.
